title.english: A Letter That Has Crossed the Water

pairs.target: fǎnchéng nàtiān lú shí sòng tāmen zhè yìbān kè dào shàngyóu huànchē chù , shuǐ bǐ qiánrì wěn xiē , réng bù zǒu yuánlái zhuānghuò xiǎng qù de jiù kǒu .
pairs.english: On return day Lushi took that passenger group to the upstream cart transfer. Water was calmer than before, but she still avoided the old freight landing.
pairs.hanzi: 返程那天芦实送他们这一班客到上游换车处，水比前日稳些，仍不走原来装货想去的旧口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò dào zuórì biérén zuò guò de dìfāng , wèi lǐ méi zài kōngluòluò de , dǎo xiān wénjiàn zìjǐ bāo lǐ guǒ zhe de gān bǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi sat where someone else had sat yesterday, stomach no longer hollow, noticing instead the dry bread wrapped in his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐到昨日别人坐过的地方，胃里没再空落落的，倒先闻见自己包里裹着的干饼。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhī sòngdào shàngchuán chù . tā kàn tā kòuhǎo bāo , biàn qù wèn lìng yíwèi chuángōng wǔhòu de shuǐwèi , méi zhàn zài ànshàng děng chuán yǐng quán bújiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai saw him only to boarding. Once his bag was fastened, she asked another boat worker about afternoon water levels, not waiting ashore until the boat vanished.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾只送到上船处。她看他扣好包，便去问另一位船工午后的水位，没站在岸上等船影全不见。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huíguò yícì tóu , kànjiàn tā cè zhe shēn tīng rén shuōhuà , màoyán yādī , nà zhī xīn pí kòu zài jiāntóu shǎnleyíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi looked back once at her listening sideways, hat brim low, the new buckle flashing at her shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回过一次头，看见她侧着身听人说话，帽檐压低，那只新皮扣在肩头闪了一下。

pairs.target: chuán jiēchē , dāngwǎn zhù bái péng yì ; cìrì huàn wǎng běi de gōnglù chē , yòu zài lùshang zhù yíyè .
pairs.english: Boat connected to cart, then a night at White Awning Station; next day a northbound road cart and another night on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 船接车，当晚住白棚驿；次日换往北的公路车，又在路上住一夜。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shuǐbiān nà zhāng liúdǐ dǎkāi shí , kèdiàn lǎobǎn zhèng wèn tāmen yào buyào jiā yìchuáng báobèi , chuāngwài de yèfēng yǐjīng búshì shí tīng nà gǔ shī nuǎn .
pairs.english: When Tavi opened his river copy, the innkeeper was offering a light extra quilt; the night air outside no longer had Shiting's damp warmth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把水边那张留底打开时，客店老板正问他们要不要加一床薄被，窗外的夜风已经不是石汀那股湿暖。

pairs.target: tā yìng le , jiāng zhǐ yā dào bù yíng chuāng de dìfāng , méiyǒu ná dēng dīng dào bànyè .
pairs.english: He accepted, weighted the papers away from the window, and didn't study them by lamplight until midnight.
pairs.hanzi: 他应了，将纸压到不迎窗的地方，没有拿灯盯到半夜。

pairs.target: dìsāntiān xiàwǔ huídào fēng zhàn , ruǎn héng xiān jiēguò tā bēibāo , wèn chuánshàng kě tǔ le . tǎ wéi shuō qù shí xiǎnxiē , huí shí méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Back in Wind Trestle the third afternoon, Ruan Heng took his pack and asked whether he'd been sick aboard. Nearly outward, Tavi said, but not returning.
pairs.hanzi: 第三天下午回到风栈，阮衡先接过他背包，问船上可吐了。塔维说去时险些，回时没有。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng diǎntóu , suíhòu cái jiāng kèdiàn dàizhuǎn de duǎn bào dìgěi tā kàn , shuō xìn bǐ běnrén zǎo dào le yìtiān , liǎngtiáo àn lù de tú zìjǐ yǐjīng kànguò , dī shuǐ nà chù méi huà wán , jìde huílái yǐhòu yě bié bǔ chéng huà wán le .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng showed him the forwarded report: it had arrived a day early. He'd seen both shore maps; remember, returning didn't mean completing the unchecked low-water stretch on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡点头，随后才将客店代转的短报递给他看，说信比本人早到了一天，两条岸路的图自己已经看过，低水那处没画完，记得回来以后也别补成画完了。

pairs.target: " háiyǒu yìfēng . " tā shuō . nà fēngxìn jiá zài xuégōng zhuǎn lái de zhǐ lǐ , bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de báo .
pairs.english: “There's another,” he said. It lay among academy-forwarded papers, thinner than Tavi expected.
pairs.hanzi:
“还有一封。”他说。
那封信夹在学宫转来的纸里，比塔维想的薄。

pairs.target: fēngpí xiě de búshì wū yà , yě búshì xǔ lián , yòuxiàjiǎo shì chí ān liǎnggè zì . tā kàn le yíbiàn , cái shēnshǒu qù ná , zhǐjiān pèngdào zhé biān , jìng xiān xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài bái jiē de shíjiē shàng rènzì shí , zǒng pà kàn cuò yígè biàn jiāng hòutou quán kàn cuò .
pairs.english: The envelope named neither Wuya nor Xu Lian: Chian, in the lower right. He read it before taking it, fingers touching the fold, remembering his fear on the White Steps that one misread character would make everything after it wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 封皮写的不是乌娅，也不是许莲，右下角是迟安两个字。他看了一遍，才伸手去拿，指尖碰到折边，竟先想起自己在白阶的石阶上认字时，总怕看错一个便将后头全看错。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi zhàn zài ménkǒu děng zhe . tā jiāng bēibāo fàngdào tǎ wéi de yǐ biān , qù lóuxià zhǎoshuǐ , fánglǐ zhī shèng miànbāo pù lúzǐ tòushànglái de rèqì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng didn't wait in the doorway. He put the pack by Tavi's chair and went downstairs for water, leaving only bakery-oven warmth in the room.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没站在门口等着。他将背包放到塔维的椅边，去楼下找水，房里只剩面包铺炉子透上来的热气。

pairs.target: chí ān de zì yǒuxiē jǐ , jǐchù xiě zhòng le . tā xiān shuō xǔ lián bǎ wèn xìn zhuǎngěi zìjǐ , zìjǐ rújīn réng zài sōng dī liángmù chǎng zuòhuó , wèn le shēnbiān yígè niánzhǎng de shīfu , cái zhīdào zěnyàng jiāng huíxìn jì dào bái jiē xuégōng de zhuǎn xìn chù .
pairs.english: Chian's handwriting was cramped and overwritten in places. Xu Lian had forwarded the inquiry; he still worked at Songdi Timber Yard and had asked an older craftsman how to send a reply through the White Steps academy.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安的字有些挤，几处写重了。他先说许莲把问信转给自己，自己如今仍在松堤梁木场做活，问了身边一个年长的师傅，才知道怎样将回信寄到白阶学宫的转信处。

pairs.target: " fú lán zhè míngzì , shì nǐ xìn lǐ xiě de , wǒ zìjǐ bùgǎn shuō jìde . " tā zài xià yìháng xiě , " sòng wǒmen lái de nàwèi nǚrén , wǒ jìde hái huílái guò yícì . shì gé le yírì háishì liǎngrì , rújīn dá bùzhǔn , zhī jìde shì wǎnfàn yǐhòu . "
pairs.english: “Fulan is the name in your letter; I can't claim I remember it,” he wrote. “I remember the woman who brought us returning once. One day later or two, I can't say now. Only after dinner.”
pairs.hanzi: “芙兰这名字，是你信里写的，我自己不敢说记得。”他在下一行写，“送我们来的那位女人，我记得还回来过一次。是隔了一日还是两日，如今答不准，只记得是晚饭以后。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhǐ wǎng chuāngqián nuó le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi moved the paper closer to the window.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将纸往窗前挪了一点。

pairs.target: chí ān shuō nàcì nǚrén dàihuí yìzhī bǔ hǎo de mùxié , gěi tóng yuàn yígè jiào ā qiǎo de nǚhái . ā qiǎo xiān xián xié zhòng , chuān shàng hòu què bùkěn tuō , zǒulù gùyì tà dé hěn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Chian said she brought back a repaired wooden clog for a girl called Aqiao in the same courtyard. Aqiao complained of its weight, then refused to take it off and deliberately stamped loudly.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安说那次女人带回一只补好的木鞋，给同院一个叫阿巧的女孩。阿巧先嫌鞋重，穿上后却不肯脱，走路故意踏得很响。

pairs.target: nǚrén zài ménkǎn shàng zuò guò yíhuìer , sìhū zài děng shuí , yě kěnéng zhǐshì xiējiǎo . tā jìde wūlǐ yǒurén jiào tā chī dōngxī , tā méiyǒu mǎshàng jìnqù , hòulái zěnyàng líkāi de , yǐjīng xiǎngbùqǐ .
pairs.english: The woman sat on the threshold a while, perhaps waiting for someone, perhaps only resting. He remembered someone inviting her to eat inside; she didn't go immediately, and he couldn't recall her departure.
pairs.hanzi: 女人在门槛上坐过一会儿，似乎在等谁，也可能只是歇脚。他记得屋里有人叫她吃东西，她没有马上进去，后来怎样离开的，已经想不起。

pairs.target: " wǒ pà bǎ biéde shì yě xiǎng jìnlái , xiān zhī xiě zhèxiē . ruò nǐ yào wèn tā hòulái wǎng nǎér qù , wǒ méiyǒu dáàn . nǐ hái xiǎng wèn biéde , kěyǐ xiě lái . zhǐshì wǒ zuòhuó de rìzi , bù yídìng dāngtiān biàn néng huí . "
pairs.english: “I'm afraid of mixing in other events, so only write this for now. Where she went later, I have no answer. You can write more questions, but on working days I may not reply that day.”
pairs.hanzi: “我怕把别的事也想进来，先只写这些。若你要问她后来往哪儿去，我没有答案。你还想问别的，可以写来。只是我做活的日子，不一定当天便能回。”

pairs.target: zuìhòu shì mù chǎng guǎn fáng réng kě zhuǎnjiāo de dìzhǐ . chí ān méiyǒu jiào tā lìkè qù , yě méiyǒu shuō zìjǐ céng jiàn guò yígè cáng zài huòxiāng lǐ de háizi .
pairs.english: At the end was the yard office's forwarding address. Chian neither asked him to come immediately nor claimed to have seen a child hidden in a cargo carriage.
pairs.hanzi: 最后是木场管房仍可转交的地址。迟安没有叫他立刻去，也没有说自己曾见过一个藏在货厢里的孩子。

pairs.target: tā zhǐshì bǎ xǔduōnián qián yídùn wǎnfàn hòu hái néng jìzhù de nà yìdiǎn , rènzhēn xiěgěi le yígè mòshēngrén .
pairs.english: He'd simply written carefully to a stranger the little he remembered after a dinner many years ago.
pairs.hanzi: 他只是把许多年前一顿晚饭后还能记住的那一点，认真写给了一个陌生人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dúwán , yòu cóngtóu dú le yíbiàn . nàge cǎi zhe mùxié zǒu dé hěn xiǎng de nǚhái , xiānqián zhǐshì zhǐ shàng tóng chí ān bìngpái de yígè míngzì , rújīn jìng zài tā nǎo zhōng yǒu le shēngxiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi reread from the beginning. The girl stamping in wooden shoes had been only a name beside Chian's on paper; now she had a sound in his mind.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读完，又从头读了一遍。那个踩着木鞋走得很响的女孩，先前只是纸上同迟安并排的一个名字，如今竟在他脑中有了声响。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng zhīdào nǚrén děng de shì shuí , xiǎng dé hěn jí , shǒu què méiyǒu lìkè qù ná dìtú .
pairs.english: He urgently wanted to know whom she'd waited for, but didn't reach for a map immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 他想知道女人等的是谁，想得很急，手却没有立刻去拿地图。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tíshuǐ huílái shí , tā wèn néngfǒu tì zìjǐ yě dú yíbiàn , pà yǒu yíjù bèi zìjǐ kànlòu . ruǎn héng zuòxià dúwán , jiāng gé le yírì háishì liǎngrì nà jǐgè zì zhǐ gěi tā , yòu bǎ jìde huílái guò nà yíjù dòu le yícì , méiyǒu tì tā jiāng sìhū zài děng shuí gǎichéng kěndìng .
pairs.english: When Ruan Heng returned with water, he asked him to read too, fearing a missed sentence. Ruan Heng pointed to the words one day or two and reread the sentence remembered her returning, not changing perhaps waiting for someone into certainty.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡提水回来时，他问能否替自己也读一遍，怕有一句被自己看漏。阮衡坐下读完，将隔了一日还是两日那几个字指给他，又把记得回来过那一句读了一次，没有替他将似乎在等谁改成肯定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , jiāng xìn píng fàngzài zhuōshàng , lìng qǔ zhǐ bǎ quánwén chāo gěi sè lā . kāitóu xiěmíng zhè shì chí ān rújīn de huíyì , búshì jiù bó lǐ dāngrì jìxià dehuà ; tā kěyǐ tóng tā kàn tóng yìfēng , búbì zhī tīng yíjù yǒurén zhōngyú huílái le .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded and copied the whole letter for Sela, noting first this was Chian's present recollection, not a contemporary register entry. She could read the same letter, not merely hear that someone had finally returned.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，将信平放在桌上，另取纸把全文抄给瑟拉。开头写明这是迟安如今的回忆，不是旧簿里当日记下的话；她可以同他看同一封，不必只听一句有人终于回来了。

pairs.target: gǎn zài miànbāo pù shōu dài yǐqián , tā bǎ fùběn tóng duǎnjiān fùqián jìchū . gěi chí ān de huíxìn hái méi xiě hǎo , tā liú le yìzhāng gānjìng de zhǐ , méi jí zhe jiāng suǒyǒu wèntí jǐ zài dìyīháng .
pairs.english: Before the bakery mailbag closed, he paid to post the copy and note. His reply to Chian wasn't written yet; he left a clean sheet without cramming every question onto its first line.
pairs.hanzi: 赶在面包铺收袋以前，他把副本同短笺付钱寄出。给迟安的回信还没写好，他留了一张干净的纸，没急着将所有问题挤在第一行。

pairs.target: lóuxià yǒurén jiào chīfàn , ruǎn héng zài ménwài yìng le yìshēng , yòu wèn tā xià bu xiàqù . tǎ wéi jiāng yuán xìn jiá dào zìjǐ de jìlù páng , qǐshēn shí yǐ jiǎo xiǎng le yíxià . tā zhànzhù , tīngjiàn jiēshàng yǒurén chuānzhe yìng dǐ xié zǒuguò , shēngxiǎng hěn jìn , suíhòu yòu yuǎn le .
pairs.english: Someone called dinner downstairs. Ruan Heng answered outside and asked if he was coming. Tavi filed the original beside his records; the chair creaked as he rose. He paused, hearing hard-soled footsteps in the street, close and then fading away.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下有人叫吃饭，阮衡在门外应了一声，又问他下不下去。塔维将原信夹到自己的记录旁，起身时椅脚响了一下。他站住，听见街上有人穿着硬底鞋走过，声响很近，随后又远了。
